raw_context:
TELUS operates several major consumer-facing wireless, internet, and specialized service brands under its corporate umbrella, including
Koodo Mobile
Public Mobile
TELUS Health
, and
TELUS International
Mobile and Wireless Brands
TELUS Mobility:
The flagship brand offering premium postpaid and prepaid 5G/5G+ services.
Koodo Mobile:
A mid-tier flanker brand focused on value-conscious users and streamlined mobile plans.
Public Mobile:
A digital-first, low-cost prepaid SIM/eSIM value brand.
Reddit
r/PublicMobile
Home and Business Services
TELUS Communications / Internet / TV:
Provides residential fiber internet, home phone, and streaming/IPTV services
TELUS Smart Home Security:
Offers home monitoring, automation, and security hardware.
Mascon by TELUS:
Regional residential internet and cable provider operating mostly in British Columbia and Ontario.
Specialized & Global Operations
TELUS Health:
Digital health, virtual care, and pharmacy services for individuals and corporate wellness plans.
TELUS International:
A global digital customer experience (CX) and IT services company.
